 This is a high\-impact, product\-facing role for a seasoned banking and finance lawyer who can operate at the intersection of financial services regulation and cutting\-edge technology, ensuring Zeta’s products, partnerships, and client programs are designed and delivered in a manner that is legally sound and regulator\-ready. * Ownership and adaptability: Proactive self\-starter, energized by ambiguity, comfortable in unfamiliar areas of law, takes ownership of outcomes, thrives in a collaborative, product\-driven culture at the frontier of banking and fintech.

* H ands\-on expertise across digital lending, credit and debit cards, prepaid and co\-branded card programs, payments, and fintech regulation.

description:
Head — Legal \& Compliance \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Not a general counsel with a department, and not a land\-law seat. One qualified lawyer who commands outside counsel, runs the secretarial calendar for every entity through a small team, and holds the compliance line — for a real assets platform forming a dozen entities and building fast.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Chief Financial Officer · EXPERIENCE: 8–14 years as a qualified lawyer, a meaningful part of it in\-house at a real estate or real\-assets business
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO — three institutional platforms built from zero, the fourth on his own capital; 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor) across his three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 JUDGMENT IN\-HOUSE, DRAFTING OUTSIDE
 



 Vantrock does not run a legal department in the conventional sense, and it does not intend to. Formal opinions come from external firms. Transaction documents are drafted by the counsel retained for the transaction. Litigation, where it arises, is run by litigators. What the platform keeps in\-house is the one thing that cannot be bought by the hour: the person who knows the business well enough to decide what to ask, whom to ask, when the answer is wrong, and when to say no.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 A platform forming a dozen entities, signing construction contracts, taking on lenders, bringing in institutional co\-investors and preparing a fund vehicle generates a volume of legal and secretarial work that cannot be run out of the founder's inbox and a handful of law firms' engagement letters. Today it is. The question of who owns the contract before it goes to counsel, who tracks the ROC calendar across a dozen entities, who tells the founder that a clause he has agreed in principle is a problem — has no answer inside the building.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. Corporate legal, commanded. Every contract, transaction, structure and dispute scoped by you before counsel is engaged, briefed by you, reviewed by you before it is signed — and the internal view formed first, so that outside counsel is answering the right question.
 



 2\. The empanelled firms. Choose them, brief them, hold them to fee and quality, and know which firm to use for what.
 



 3\. The secretarial calendar for every entity. Board and partner meetings, resolutions, statutory registers, ROC and LLP filings, annual compliance — for the development company, the investment manager, the sponsor vehicles and every project entity.
 



 4\. The compliance line. A single register of what the group must do, by when, under which law or contract — statutory, regulatory, investor undertakings, with lender covenants mirrored from the corporate finance team's calendar — with an owner and a status against every line, reviewed monthly with the CFO.

description:
Counsel — Land \& Transaction Risk \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Not a law\-firm seat and not a compliance seat. Every asset this platform buys starts as land, and the founder's own capital goes in first – so title, tenure and approval risk sit with us, not with an investor. This seat controls that risk: it commissions the country's best firms, holds them to the standard and the date, and turns what comes back into a decision.
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain – first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use developments with distribution below and office above. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



  
 



 Two decades on this ground and a gap institutional capital left open below the 100\-acre logistics park. The first phase: 10\-to\-50\-acre parcels taken through approvals quickly on the founder's own capital and turned into 2\.5 lakh to 1\.2 million sq ft campuses – shovel\-ready before an investor is ever asked to commit. Pipeline 10 million sq ft; ground breaks on the first 2 million sq ft in January 2027\.
 



  
 



 Three parts, kept deliberately separate. The founder's own balance sheet takes the first risk. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited – the employer for this seat – is the development manager and operator, with its own board, team and governance. Vantrock Investment Managers LLP is the investment manager; its team underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter a strategy at cost, with no founder premium, and the platform earns only after its investors have.
 



  
 



 Vantrock was founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital. 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), over 2,000 acres acquired, all litigation\-free, more than 200 buildings, and two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. We don't hire roles. We build the platform.
 



  
 



 THE LAND \& INVESTMENTS TEAM
 



 The Land \& Investments team originates, underwrites, structures and closes the land and platform transactions the pipeline is built from, and stays with each asset for its life. The legal function inside it is deliberately two people – a Counsel and a Paralegal. It controls land risk and turnaround across a national pipeline rather than doing the volume work: the country's best land practices do that, and the Big Four advisers do the tax. Judgment, standards, dates and the file stay in\-house.
 



  
 



 THE SEAT
 



 Reports to: Chief Investment Officer / Head of Land \& Investments. Dotted line to the Chief Financial Officer.

 Team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and the hiring entity described here reflect the current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.

 Every asset this platform buys starts as land, and every land deal carries a legal risk that either gets found before signing or gets paid for afterwards. The founder's own capital goes in first, before any investor is asked to commit, which means title, tenure, encumbrance and approval risk are absorbed by the house and not passed on. This seat is where that risk is controlled.
 



  
 



 The Counsel is not the person who writes the opinion – the country's best land practices do that, and will keep doing it. This seat commissions them, structures the question, holds them to the standard and the date, and translates what comes back into price, structure and whether we proceed. Nobody knows every state's land law and we are not looking for someone who claims to: the record changes name and shape at every border – 7/12 and mutation entries in Maharashtra, Record of Rights and pahani in Karnataka, chitta, adangal and patta in Tamil Nadu, khasra and jamabandi in the north – and what we need is someone who can land in a new state, work out what the record proves, instruct the right counsel and come back with an answer. Resourceful, street\-smart, solution\-minded; the answer is rarely in a textbook.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. Own land risk on every live transaction.
 



 2\. Command the firms.
 



 3\. Own the turnaround clock.
 



 4\. Build and hold the gold standard.
 



 5\. Own stamp duty, registration and the tax read.
 



 6\. Read the paper record for what it actually says.
 



 7\. Structure and paper the transaction, then close it.
 



  
 



 TRAVEL IS A REAL AND CENTRAL PART OF THIS SEAT
 



 Not an occasional site visit. Expect to be out of Mumbai a meaningful part of every month, in the states where our deals sit: at the parcel, in revenue and sub\-registrar offices, in local counsel's chambers, and across the table from landowners and their lawyers. Records in India are not fully digital and the risks that matter are rarely the ones already written into a report. If travelling to a tehsil office in a state whose language you do not speak sounds like the wrong kind of work, this is not your seat.

 – At least five years of relevant land and real estate property law. Total years of experience are not the filter; those five are.

 – Hands\-on title diligence on land: chain of title, revenue records, encumbrance, tenure and conversion, litigation search — on deals you personally worked, not supervised from a distance.

 What this role is not
 



 – Not a general corporate or compliance seat. Company law, securities and fund compliance sit elsewhere in the group; this seat is land and the transactions built on it.
 



 – Not a litigation seat. Disputes are handled by counsel; you assess what a dispute does to a deal.

We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely. Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: performance\-linked bonuses and ESOP\-linked incentives, priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.

**Group Company Secretary \& Head – Global Governance**
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn’t a typical Company Secretary role.
   

  

 You will serve as the
 **governance backbone of CoinDCX’s global entity structure** 
 , ensuring statutory compliance, board governance, and regulatory discipline across India, Dubai, Mauritius, Jordan, and any future jurisdictions.
   

  

 This role exists to build and safeguard the company’s governance architecture as we scale globally in a highly regulated industry. You will act as the custodian of global compliance standards across Finance, HR, Compliance, and Legal functions, ensuring our governance framework is robust, audit\-ready, and aligned with potential future listing requirements.
   

  

 You will work closely with the CFO, Legal, Compliance, Board members, and external advisors to drive best\-in\-class governance standards across all entities.

* Lead global corporate governance across all CoinDCX entities, ensuring statutory compliance and governance alignment across jurisdictions.

 You will work closely with senior leadership, influence high\-stakes structural decisions, and help shape the governance architecture of one of India’s most trusted crypto platforms. This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of compliance, capital markets, and global scale.

**Where We Work**

 **Mumbai office** 
 , where governance, leadership alignment, and execution move in real time.

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**

 Join CoinDCX and help us build the future of finance — responsibly, globally, and together.
